newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico says could issue bonds to pay for Aztecs.
newsitem.headline: Mexico says could issue bonds to pay for Aztecs.

text.p: Mexico could issue new bonds in the medium term to help fund its early repayment of some $1.058 billion in Aztec bonds, officials said on Wednesday.
"There could be issues in the future that are aimed at (repayment of the Aztecs)," Alejandro Valenzuela, the Finance Ministry spokesman, told reporters.

"The money could be covered in a variety of ways.... We have a variety of options these days that permit us to refinance that money easily and in a way that helps Mexico," he said during a regularly scheduled news conference.
Mexico on Tuesday said it would buy back its outstanding Aztec bonds, part of a strategy to decrease the country's financing costs.
